verdict.why_untestable: lambda=0 already attains the oracle within 1%, so no penalty can improve the recommendation regardless of how optimism is measured
verdict.note: Verified reversal is scored by the simulator oracle, never by the model whose predictions the search maximised. Comparisons are paired by seed, so network, data and fitted model are identical and only lambda differs. When search_saturated_at_oracle is true the search already attains the best possible set, leaving no headroom for the penalty, and H3 is untestable in that regime rather than refuted. A negative optimism gap means the model underestimates reversal, which is the expected effect of its magnitude shrinkage and masks the optimiser's curse.
